title: helianthemum vulgare proles chamaecistus
intro: Helianthemum vulgare proles chamaecistus, commonly known as Rockrose, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Cistaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and other mental health issues due to its calming effects. The health benefits of Rockrose are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include sedation, anxiolysis, and antispasmodic properties, making it a valuable remedy for stress and sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents of Rockrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
